passages.text:
Re: Call on Jigsaw's Anti-Disinformation Pilot Project
[opaque block] [contact omitted] Clement Wolf Friday, September 2, 2022 at 5:30:24 PM Eastern Daylight Time
Io: [contact omitted] Vera Zakem, [opaque block] [contact omitted] Josh Blumenfeld, [opaque block] [contact omitted] Ria Strasser-Galvis,
[opaque block] [contact omitted] Alexandria Walden
Cc: [contact omitted] Amy Malessa, [contact omitted] Shadrach Ludeman, [contact omitted] Oren Murphy
Hi all (and nice to be in touch again Vera!)
My apologies for being slow to respond to these messages.
I'm adding my colleagues [contact omitted] Blumenfeld, [contact omitted] Strasser-Galvis, and [contact omitted] Walden for their visibility.
We'd of course be happy to walk you through this effort. I'll be out of the office next week but I'm hopeful others on this
thread can help move things forward in my absence; and look forward to conversing with you upon my return!
Best,
Clement
On Wed, Aug 31, 2022 at 5:08 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Clement,
Nice to meet you! Although, I think we may have crossed paths a bit in tech!!
Would love to circle back on this as well. By way of background -
I joined USAID 4 months ago to lead the Agency's efforts on tech and democracy, and holistically on addressing
disinformation.
Looking forward to connecting.
thanks! vera
On Wed, Aug 31, 2022 at 1:49 PM Amy Malessa <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Looping in Vera Zakem, the Agency's new Senior Advisor for Technology and Democracy, who is also interested in
the pilot. Thanks everyone!
Amy Noreuil Malessa
Senior Digital Technology Advisor for Field Programs Division
Bureau for Conflict Prevention and Stabilization | Office of Transition Initiatives | Creative Digital Team
US Agency for International Development
Mobile: [opaque block] | [contact omitted]
On Thu, Aug 25, 2022 at 9:42 AM Amy Malessa <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Clement,
Thanks again for our call earlier this summer with Alex and Ria.
Our programs in Europe are interested in learning more about Jigsaw's anti-disinformation pilot project. I'm
copying our Country Representative for Ukraine, Shadrach Ludeman, and our Regional Advisor for Europe, Oren
Murphy.
Can we set-up a call with you and Beth Goldberg to learn more soon? We can give you a quick brief on our work
with partners in the region and why we are interested in the pilot. We are flexible so please let us know what works
best for your schedules.
Thanks so much!
Amy
Amy Noreuil Malessa
Senior Digital Technology Advisor for Field Programs Division
Bureau for Conflict Prevention and Stabilization | Office of Transition Initiatives | Creative Digital Team

US Agency for International Development
